name: Glo Dollar
oneLiner: USDGLO is Brale-issued dollar stablecoin whose reserve yield is directed to extreme-poverty alleviation, redeemable 1:1 against cash and U.S. government debt.
collateral: Cash, cash equivalents, and U.S. government-backed debt held by Brale in segregated, unencumbered accounts
pegMechanism: Brale-issued fiat-backed stablecoin redeemable 1:1 for USD or USDC by eligible Brale customers; Brale manages reserves and liquidity for redemption obligations

jurisdiction.license: Money Services Business / Money Transmitter, NMLS ID #2376957

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDGLO is a Brale-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin with 1:1 redemption and monthly attestations.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for USDGLO. Brale operates as a FinCEN-registered MSB with state money-transmitter licenses; no OCC charter application or PPSI announcement found as of 2026-06-07.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDGLO is a GloDollarV3 ERC1967 UUPS proxy (AccessControl, non-enumerable) deployed at the same address across ETH/Base/Optimism/Celo/Polygon/Arbitrum; Brale issues it 1:1 through their centralized backend. MINTER_ROLE holders cannot be enumerated on-chain without a full historical event scan.

controls.label: Brale issuance backend
controls.evidence: Brale operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for USDGLO for eligible Brale customers against segregated cash and US government-backed debt; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295105 (2026-06-11): USDGLO (0x4f604735c1cf31399c6e711d5962b2b3e0225ad3) is a live ERC1967 UUPS proxy (impl=GloDollarV3 0xf8db…, confirmed on Blockscout). totalSupply=320,357 tokens; paused()=false. GloDollarV3 uses AccessControl (non-enumerable) — getRoleMemberCount/getRoleMember absent from ABI, all enumeration calls revert. RoleGranted and Transfer-from-zero log scans in last 49,000 blocks returned 0 results on ETH, Base, Celo, and Polygon. Stellar issuer (GBBS25…) has 1 signer, weight=1. Brale-issued model confirmed from issuer materials.
unresolvedQuestions: GloDollarV3 uses non-enumerable AccessControl; enumerate MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders via a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scan from ETH deployment block ~15,921,266 (or Brale direct disclosure) before raising to verified.
